title: ESALC-I SCT/ZCT and Miller HDCPT2 Wang-Landau kinetics
summary: Native internal-coordinate covariant path curvature and centrifugal-dominant SCT/ZCT; certified local Miller channels and finite-action HDC occupation thermal flux. Anharmonic ZPE is unregularized ground-only perturbation theory. HDCPT2 applies to excited spacings. Synthetic mathematical qualification only; no molecular benchmark or global saddle extrapolation is certified.
gates: Native nonredundant ESALC-I F2/F3/F4/G/G1/G2 with explicit quartic coverage and coordinate identity
Exactly one unstable saddle mode; the reactive coordinate is never a bound occupation
SCT and Miller use identical saddle tensors; covariant cubic TS curvature and path-Hessian continuation
Anharmonic ZPE from vacuum perturbation with positive frequency-sum denominators, without HDC regularization
HDCPT2 excitation polynomial and existing SENTINEL Wang-Landau; common finite occupation support and independent replicas
SCT single monotone-sided adiabatic barrier, stable transverse modes and owner-confirmed asymptotes
Scalar HDC action-domain monotonicity certificate; finite-window rate labels and endpoint terms retained
All energies and reactant partition functions share one origin; ZPE and barrier counted once
Local synthetic qualification does not certify deep-tunneling asymptotes or molecular rate accuracy
coordinate_policy: Native ESALC-I partial potential derivatives and contravariant metric derivatives. Covariant curvature includes Levi-Civita terms. Arc length in bohr sqrt(amu). Transverse fields must be prepared in the local constrained gauge.
backend_policy: Native postprocessing only. LINK/electronic field acquisition is upstream and separately authorized. SCT is an alternative to Miller, not a multiplicative correction to it. HDC rates retain finite local support.
